description: Compare and focus observed provider/model routes and runtime (oppi, durable, pi-tui). Missing provider, model, or runtime tags are untagged. Operational success is not accepted-task correctness. Use the Provider, Model, and Runtime dropdowns to isolate a set.

options.content:
Use **Provider**, **Model**, and **Runtime** at the top to compare a set or focus one route. Missing `provider`+`model` tags, and missing `runtime`, are **untagged**.

Bars and tables are mechanical: TTFT, cost, turn/tool errors, USD per 1k output tokens. The runtime table breaks those down by oppi, durable, and pi-tui. `status=ok` is not accepted-task correctness. Do not read these as TPS or quality. Pair with `npm run telemetry:review -- --models` for p50/p95 and the runtime breakdown.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.turn'
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.runtime')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${runtime:sqlstring})

panels.description: SUM(cost_usd_micros) / SUM(output_tokens) of server.turn_usage as USD per 1k output tokens. Efficiency, not quality. Both fields are sum-aggregated.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END AS route,
  ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.cost_usd_micros') ELSE 0 END)
  / MAX(1.0, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.output_tokens') ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0),
  4
) AS usd_per_1k_out
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.turn_usage'
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.runtime')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${runtime:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.output_tokens') ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY usd_per_1k_out DESC

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT

  1
) AS turn_err_pct,
  ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
  1
) AS tool_err_pct
FROM events
WHERE name IN ('server.turn', 'server.turn_ttft', 'server.turn_usage', 'server.tool_call')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.runtime')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${runtime:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN runtime = 'untagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cost_usd DESC, turns DESC

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.tool')), ''), 'unknown') AS tool,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS calls,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS errors,
  ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
  1
) AS err_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 0) AS duration_avg_ms
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.tool_call'
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.runtime')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${runtime:sqlstring})

panels.description: Exact provider/model comparison for the selected set. Averages only; p50/p95 stay in telemetry:review --models.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END AS route,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS turns,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_ttft' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END), 0) AS ttft_avg_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) / 1000.0, 1) AS turn_avg_s,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.tool_calls') ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS tool_starts,
  ROUND(
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.tool_calls') ELSE 0 END), 0) AS REAL)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    2
  ) AS tools_per_turn,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.cost_usd_micros') ELSE 0 END) / 1000000.0, 2) AS cost_usd,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.cost_usd_micros') ELSE 0 END) / 1000000.0)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    4
  ) AS usd_per_turn,
  ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.cost_usd_micros') ELSE 0 END)
  / MAX(1.0, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.output_tokens') ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0),
  4
) AS usd_per_1k_out,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn_usage' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.output_tokens') ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS output_tokens,
  ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.turn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
  1
) AS turn_err_pct,
  ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'server.tool_call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
  1
) AS tool_err_pct
FROM events
WHERE name IN ('server.turn', 'server.turn_ttft', 'server.turn_usage', 'server.tool_call')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.runtime')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${runtime:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
HAVING turns > 0 OR tool_starts > 0 OR cost_usd > 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN route = 'untagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cost_usd DESC, turns DESC

  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.runtime')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${runtime:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING calls > 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN route = 'untagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, calls DESC, tool
